'Milk-fed lamb on the grill.' Notice how Russian expresses 'milk-fed' and 'grill' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Baked plums with berries.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'baked' before landing on 'berries'.
'Rabbit with rosemary.' Chef Barinov brings out the contrast between 'rabbit' and 'with' in a few short words.
